versions.content: Implementation . codeDescriptor For each available form of component code a Code element is used. For each codeDescriptor , all rel- evant artifacts are then referenced through the attribute artifactDescriptor (class AutosarEngineeringObject ) which in turn references to a catalog of available files through a set of attributes as shown below. If for instance a component implementa- tion is given as source code only, then the respective Implementation would contain exactly one codeDescriptor , whose artifactDescriptor . category attribute would denote the files to be source files.
